### The Spirit’s Power - Truth For Life - May 8
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-may-8-2024.html
Passage: Acts 1:8
Points:
- The Holy Spirit is granted to believers so that God's people can carry His truth to the world.
- The disciples were dramatically transformed from fearful men hiding indoors into bold public witnesses.
- Jesus expanded their vision beyond national borders to reach all nations and peoples.
- Believers possess the same Spirit today and are tasked with evangelizing locally and globally.
- Proclaiming Christ across hostile divides demands relying on divine power rather than human strength.

### PowerPoint - Jan. 8, 2010
Author: Jack Graham
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/powerpoint/powerpoint-jan-8-2010-11624670.html
Passage: Acts 1:8
Points:
- Many believers hesitate to speak of Christ out of fear of rejection or ridicule.
- Jesus granted the Holy Spirit at Pentecost to empower His followers as witnesses.
- Christians receive salvation once, but need continual daily fillings of the Spirit.
- Yielding daily authority to the Holy Spirit unlocks God's supernatural power in a believer's life.
